articles.abstract_en: We present a model of online content sharing where agents sequentially observe an article and decide whether to share it with others. This content may or may not contain misinformation. Each agent starts with an ideological bias and gains utility from positive social media interactions but does not want to be called out for propagating misinformation. We characterize the (Bayesian–Nash) equilibria of this social media game and establish that it exhibits strategic complementarities. Under this framework, we study how a platform interested in maximizing engagement would design its algorithm. Our main result establishes that when the relevant articles have low-reliability and are thus likely to contain misinformation, the engagement-maximizing algorithm takes the form of a “filter bubble”—creating an echo chamber of like-minded users. Moreover, filter bubbles become more likely when there is greater polarization in society and content is more divisive. Finally, we discuss various regulatory solutions to such platform-manufactured misinformation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个在线内容分享模型，其中个体依次观察一篇文章并决定是否与他人分享。该内容可能包含也可能不包含错误信息。每个个体起初具有意识形态偏见，并从积极的社交媒体互动中获得效用，但不想因传播错误信息而被指责。我们刻画了该社交媒体博弈的（贝叶斯-纳什）均衡，并确立其表现出策略互补性。在此框架下，我们研究了以最大化参与度为目标平台将如何设计其算法。我们的主要结果表明，当相关文章可靠性低且因此可能包含错误信息时，最大化参与度的算法采取“过滤气泡”的形式——创造志同道合用户的回音室。此外，当社会两极分化更严重且内容更具分裂性时，过滤气泡更可能出现。最后，我们讨论了针对此类平台制造的错误信息的各种监管解决方案。

articles.title_en: Decomposing Duration Dependence in a Stopping Time Model
articles.title_cn: 在停时模型中分解持续时间依赖性
articles.abstract_en: We develop an economic model of transitions in and out of employment. Heterogeneous workers switch employment status when the net benefit from working, a Brownian motion with drift, hits optimally chosen barriers. This implies that the duration of jobless spells for each worker has an inverse Gaussian distribution. We allow for arbitrary heterogeneity across workers and prove that the distribution of inverse Gaussian distributions is partially identified from the duration of two non-employment spells for each worker. We estimate the model using Austrian social security data and find that dynamic selection is a critical source of duration dependence.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个关于就业状态进出转换的经济模型。异质性工人在工作的净收益（一个带漂移的布朗运动）触及最优选择的障碍时切换就业状态。这意味着每个工人失业持续时间的分布为逆高斯分布。我们允许工人之间存在任意异质性，并证明逆高斯分布的分布可以从每个工人的两次非就业持续时间中部分识别。我们使用奥地利社会保障数据估计该模型，并发现动态选择是持续时间依赖性的关键来源。

articles.title_en: Strategic Foundations of Efficient Rational Expectations
articles.title_cn: 有效理性预期的策略基础
articles.abstract_en: We study an economy with traders whose payoffs are quasilinear and whose private signals are informative about an unobserved state parameter. The limit economy has infinitely many traders partitioned into a finite set of symmetry classes called types. Market mechanisms in a class that includes auctions yield the same outcome as the Walrasian rational expectations equilibrium if and only if the efficient allocation has a monotonicity property. Examples illustrate cases where they differ. Monotonicity restricts the heterogeneity among traders’ types.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个经济，其中交易者的收益是拟线性的，他们的私人信号关于一个未观测的状态参数具有信息量。极限经济中有无限多个交易者，被划分为有限个称为类型的对称类。包括拍卖在内的市场机制类别，当且仅当有效配置具有单调性性质时，产生与瓦尔拉斯理性预期均衡相同的结果。例子说明了它们不同的情况。单调性限制了交易者类型之间的异质性。

articles.title_en: Revisiting Event-Study Designs: Robust and Efficient Estimation
articles.title_cn: 重新审视事件研究设计：稳健且高效的估计
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework for difference-in-differences designs with staggered treatment adoption and heterogeneous causal effects. We show that conventional regression-based estimators fail to provide unbiased estimates of relevant estimands absent strong restrictions on treatment-effect homogeneity. We then derive the efficient estimator addressing this challenge, which takes an intuitive “imputation” form when treatment-effect heterogeneity is unrestricted. We characterize the asymptotic behaviour of the estimator, propose tools for inference, and develop tests for identifying assumptions. Our method applies with time-varying controls, in triple-difference designs, and with certain non-binary treatments. We show the practical relevance of our results in a simulation study and an application. Studying the consumption response to tax rebates in the U.S., we find that the notional marginal propensity to consume is between 8 and 11% in the first quarter—about half as large as benchmark estimates used to calibrate macroeconomic models—and predominantly occurs in the first month after the rebate.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架，用于处理交错采用处理和异质性因果效应的双重差分设计。我们表明，在缺乏对处理效应同质性的强限制下，传统的基于回归的估计器无法提供相关估计目标的无偏估计。然后，我们推导出解决这一挑战的高效估计器，当处理效应异质性不受限制时，该估计器采用一种直观的“插补”形式。我们刻画了该估计器的渐近行为，提出了推断工具，并开发了识别假设的检验。我们的方法适用于时变控制变量、三重差分设计以及某些非二元处理。我们通过模拟研究和应用展示了我们结果的实际相关性。通过研究美国税收返还的消费反应，我们发现名义边际消费倾向在第一季度介于8和11%%之间——约为用于校准宏观经济模型的基准估计的一半——并且主要发生在返还后的第一个月。

articles.title_en: Outside Options in the Labour Market
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场中的外部选择
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a method to estimate workers’ outside employment opportunities. We outline a matching model with two-sided heterogeneity, from which we derive a sufficient statistic, the “outside options index” (OOI), for the effect of outside options on earnings, holding worker productivity constant. The OOI uses the cross-sectional concentration of similar workers across job types to quantify workers’ outside options as a function of workers’ commuting costs, preferences, and skills. Using German micro-data, we find that differences in options explain 20% of the gender earnings gap, and that gender gaps in options are mostly due to differences in the implicit costs of commuting and moving.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种估计工人外部就业机会的方法。我们构建了一个具有双边异质性的匹配模型，从中推导出一个充分统计量，即“外部选择指数”（OOI），用于衡量在保持工人生产率不变的情况下，外部选择对收入的影响。OOI利用相似工人在不同工作类型中的横截面集中度，将工人的外部选择量化为其通勤成本、偏好和技能的函数。利用德国微观数据，我们发现，外部选择的差异解释了20%的性别收入差距，且性别在外部选择上的差距主要源于通勤和迁移的隐性成本差异。

articles.title_en: Marriage Market and Labour Market Sorting
articles.title_cn: 婚姻市场与劳动力市场匹配
articles.abstract_en: We develop a new equilibrium model in which households’ labour supply choices form the link between sorting on the marriage market and sorting on the labour market. We first show that in theory, the nature of home production—whether partners’ hours are complements or substitutes—shapes equilibrium labour supply as well as marriage and labour market sorting. We then estimate our model using German data to empirically assess the nature of home production, and find that spouses’ home hours are complements. We investigate to what extent complementarity in home hours drives sorting and inequality. We find that home production complementarity strengthens positive marriage sorting and reduces the gender gap in hours and in labour sorting. This puts significant downward pressure on the gender wage gap and on within-household income inequality, but fuels between-household inequality. Our estimated model sheds new light on the sources of inequality in today’s Germany, and—by identifying important shifts in home production technology toward more complementarity—on the evolution of inequality over time.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个新的均衡模型，其中家庭的劳动供给选择构成了婚姻市场匹配与劳动力市场匹配之间的联系。我们首先在理论上表明，家庭生产的性质——配偶的工作时间究竟是互补还是替代——塑造了均衡劳动供给以及婚姻和劳动力市场的匹配。然后，我们使用德国数据估计我们的模型，以实证评估家庭生产的性质，并发现配偶的家庭工作时间是互补的。我们研究了家庭工作时间互补性在多大程度上驱动了匹配和不平等。我们发现，家庭生产互补性加强了正向的婚姻匹配，并缩小了工作时间及劳动力匹配方面的性别差距。这对性别工资差距和家庭内部收入不平等产生了显著的下行压力，但加剧了家庭间的不平等。我们估计的模型为当今德国不平等的来源提供了新的视角，并且——通过识别家庭生产技术向更大互补性的重要转变——为不平等随时间的演变提供了新的视角。

articles.title_en: The Work-From-Home Technology Boon and its Consequences
articles.title_cn: 居家办公技术的繁荣及其后果
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of widespread adoption of work-from-home (WFH) technology using an equilibrium model where people choose where to live, how to allocate their time between working at home and at the office, and how much space to use in production. Motivated by cross-sectional evidence on WFH, we model WFH as a complement to work at the office. Simulations of the model indicate that the pandemic induced a large change to the relative productivity of WFH that substantially increased home prices and will permanently affect incomes, income inequality, and city structure.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一个均衡模型研究居家办公（WFH）技术广泛采用的影响，在该模型中，人们选择居住地点、如何在工作时间中分配居家办公和办公室工作的时间，以及在生产中使用多少空间。基于WFH的横截面证据，我们将WFH建模为办公室工作的互补品。模型模拟表明，疫情导致WFH相对生产率发生巨大变化，大幅提高了房价，并将永久影响收入、收入不平等和城市结构。

articles.title_cn: 不对称竞赛中的自愿披露
articles.abstract_en: This article studies the incentives for interim voluntary disclosure of verifiable information in probabilistic all-pay contests with two-sided incomplete information. Private information may concern marginal cost, valuations, and ability. Our main result says that, if the contest is uniformly asymmetric, then full revelation is the unique perfect Bayesian equilibrium outcome. This is so because the weakest type of the underdog reveals her type in an attempt to moderate the favourite, while the strongest type of the favourite tries to discourage the underdog—so that the contest unravels. This strong-form disclosure principle is robust with respect to correlation, partitional evidence, randomized disclosures, sequential moves, and continuous type spaces. Moreover, the assumption of uniform asymmetry is not needed when incomplete information is one-sided. However, the principle may break down when type distributions are too similar, contestants possess commitment power, or information is unverifiable. In fact, cheap talk will always be ignored, even if mediated by a trustworthy third party.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在具有双边不完全信息的概率性全支付竞赛中，对可验证信息进行中期自愿披露的激励。私人信息可能涉及边际成本、估值和能力。我们的主要结果表明，如果竞赛是均匀不对称的，那么完全揭示是唯一的完美贝叶斯均衡结果。这是因为弱势方的最弱类型会揭示其类型以试图缓和强势方，而强势方的最强类型则试图阻止弱势方——从而使竞赛得以展开。这一强式披露原则对于相关性、分割证据、随机披露、序贯行动和连续类型空间具有稳健性。此外，当不完全信息是单边时，不需要均匀不对称的假设。然而，当类型分布过于相似、参赛者拥有承诺能力或信息不可验证时，该原则可能会失效。事实上，廉价交谈总是会被忽视，即使由可信的第三方进行调解也是如此。

articles.title_en: Information Aggregation Under Ambiguity: Theory and Experimental Evidence
articles.title_cn: 模糊下的信息聚合：理论与实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We study information aggregation in a dynamic trading model. We show theoretically that separable securities, introduced by Ostrovsky in the context of Expected Utility, no longer aggregate information if some traders have imprecise beliefs and are ambiguity averse. Moreover, these securities are prone to manipulation as the degree of information aggregation can be influenced by the initial price set by the uninformed market maker. These observations are also confirmed in our laboratory experiment using prediction markets. We define a new class of strongly separable securities, which are robust to the above considerations and show that they characterize information aggregation in both strategic and non-strategic environments. We derive several testable predictions, which we are able to confirm in the laboratory. Finally, we show theoretically that strongly separable securities are both sufficient and necessary for information aggregation but, strikingly, there does not exist a security that is strongly separable for all information structures.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究动态交易模型中的信息聚合。我们从理论上证明，由Ostrovsky在期望效用背景下引入的可分离证券，如果一些交易者具有不精确信念且厌恶模糊，则不再聚合信息。此外，这些证券容易被操纵，因为信息聚合的程度可以受到不知情的做市商设定的初始价格的影响。这些观察也在我们使用预测市场的实验室实验中得到证实。我们定义了一类新的强可分离证券，它对上述考虑具有稳健性，并表明它们在战略和非战略环境中都刻画了信息聚合。我们推导出几个可检验的预测，并在实验室中得以确认。最后，我们从理论上证明，强可分离证券对于信息聚合既是充分的也是必要的，但令人惊讶的是，不存在对所有信息结构都强可分离的证券。

articles.title_en: Measuring Diffusion Over a Large Network
articles.title_cn: 大型网络上的扩散测量
articles.abstract_en: This article introduces a measure of the diffusion of binary outcomes over a large, sparse network, when the diffusion is observed in two time periods. The measure captures the aggregated spillover effect of the state-switches in the initial period on their neighbours’ outcomes in the second period. This article introduces a causal network that captures the causal connections among the cross-sectional units over the two periods. It shows that when the researcher’s observed network contains the causal network as a subgraph, the measure of diffusion is identified as a simple, spatio-temporal dependence measure of observed outcomes. When the observed network does not satisfy this condition, but the spillover effect is non-negative, the spatio-temporal dependence measure serves as a lower bound for diffusion. Using this, a lower confidence bound for diffusion is proposed, and its asymptotic validity is established. The Monte Carlo simulation studies demonstrate the finite sample stability of the inference across a range of network configurations. The article applies the method to data on Indian villages to measure the diffusion of microfinancing decisions over households’ social networks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种在大型稀疏网络上测量二元结果扩散的方法，该扩散在两个时间段内被观测。该测量捕捉了初始时期状态转换对其邻居在第二时期结果的聚合溢出效应。本文引入了一个因果网络，该网络捕捉了两个时期内横截面单元之间的因果联系。研究表明，当研究者观测到的网络包含因果网络作为子图时，扩散测量被识别为观测结果的简单时空依赖度量。当观测网络不满足此条件，但溢出效应非负时，时空依赖度量作为扩散的下界。利用这一点，提出了扩散的置信下界，并建立了其渐近有效性。蒙特卡洛模拟研究展示了该推断在一系列网络配置下的有限样本稳定性。本文将该方法应用于印度村庄的数据，以测量小额信贷决策在家庭社交网络上的扩散。

articles.abstract_en: We provide a model of interrogations with two-sided asymmetric information. The suspect knows his status as guilty or innocent and the likely strength of the law enforcer’s evidence, which is informative about the suspect’s status and may also disprove lies. We compare prosecution errors in the equilibrium of the one-shot interrogation and in the optimal mechanism under full commitment. We describe a back-and-forth interrogation with disclosure of the evidence that implements the optimum in equilibrium without any commitment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个具有双向不对称信息的审讯模型。嫌疑人知道自己的有罪或无罪状态，以及执法者证据的可能强度，该证据能提供关于嫌疑人状态的信息，并可能揭穿谎言。我们比较了一次性审讯均衡中的起诉错误与完全承诺下最优机制中的起诉错误。我们描述了一种来回进行的审讯，其中披露证据，在无需任何承诺的情况下在均衡中实现最优。

articles.abstract_en: In matching models, pairwise-stable outcomes do not generally exist without substantial restrictions on both preferences and the topology of the network of contracts. We address the foundations of matching markets by developing a matching model with a continuum of agents that allows for arbitrary preferences and network structures. We show that pairwise-stable outcomes are guaranteed to exist. When agents can interact with multiple other counterparties, pairwise stability is too weak of a solution concept, and we argue that a refinement of it called tree stability is the most appropriate solution concept in this setting. Our main results show that tree-stable outcomes exist for arbitrary preferences and network topologies.
articles.abstract_cn: 在匹配模型中，如果没有对偏好和合同网络拓扑结构施加实质性限制，两两稳定结果通常不存在。我们通过开发一个具有连续统代理人的匹配模型来解决匹配市场的基础问题，该模型允许任意的偏好和网络结构。我们证明了两两稳定结果的存在是有保证的。当代理人可以与多个其他对手方互动时，两两稳定性作为一个解概念太弱，我们认为在这种情况下，其细化概念——树稳定性是最合适的解概念。我们的主要结果表明，对于任意的偏好和网络拓扑，树稳定结果都存在。

articles.title_en: A Dynamic Model of Input–Output Networks
articles.title_cn: 投入产出网络的动态模型
articles.abstract_en: We develop a dynamic model of input–output networks that incorporates adjustment costs of changing inputs. Our closed-form solution for the dynamics of the economy shows that temporary shocks to upstream sectors, whose output travels through long supply chains, have disproportionately significant welfare impact compared to affected sectors’ Domar weights. We conduct a spectral analysis of the U.S. production network and reveal that the welfare impact of temporary sectoral shocks can be represented by a low-dimensional, 3-factor structure.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含投入调整成本的投入产出网络动态模型。我们关于经济动态的闭式解表明，对上游部门的暂时性冲击，其产出通过长供应链传递，与受影响部门的Domar权重相比，具有不成比例的重大福利影响。我们对美国生产网络进行了谱分析，并揭示暂时性部门冲击的福利影响可以用一个低维的、3因子结构来表示。

articles.title_cn: 信贷配置与宏观经济波动
articles.abstract_en: We study the relationship between credit expansions, macroeconomic fluctuations, and financial crises using a novel database on the sectoral distribution of private credit for 117 countries since 1940. We document that, during credit booms, credit flows disproportionately to the non-tradable sector. Credit expansions to the non-tradable sector, in turn, systematically predict subsequent growth slowdowns and financial crises. In contrast, credit expansions to the tradable sector are associated with sustained output and productivity growth without a higher risk of a financial crisis. To understand these patterns, we show that firms in the non-tradable sector tend to be smaller, more reliant on loans secured by real estate, and more likely to default during crises. Our findings are consistent with models in which credit booms to the non-tradable sector are driven by easy financing conditions and amplified by collateral feedbacks, contributing to increased financial fragility and a boom–bust cycle.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个涵盖自1940年以来117个国家私人信贷部门分布的新数据库，研究了信贷扩张、宏观经济波动与金融危机之间的关系。我们发现，在信贷繁荣期间，信贷不成比例地流向非贸易部门。非贸易部门的信贷扩张随后系统性地预示着经济增长放缓和金融危机。相比之下，贸易部门的信贷扩张则与持续产出和生产率增长相关，且不伴随更高的金融危机风险。为理解这些模式，我们表明非贸易部门的企业往往规模较小，更依赖以房地产为抵押的贷款，并且在危机期间更可能违约。我们的发现与以下模型一致：非贸易部门的信贷繁荣由宽松的融资条件驱动，并通过抵押品反馈效应放大，从而加剧金融脆弱性并导致繁荣-萧条周期。

articles.title_en: Information and Bargaining through Agents: Experimental Evidence from Mexico’s Labour Courts
articles.title_cn: 信息与通过代理人谈判：来自墨西哥劳动法院的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Well-functioning courts are essential for the health of both financial and real economies. Courts function poorly in most lower-income countries, but the root causes of poor performance are not well understood. We use field experiments with ongoing cases to analyse sources of dysfunction in Mexico’s largest labour court. We provide parties with personalized predictions for case outcomes and show that this information nearly doubles settlement rates and reduces average case duration. The experiment generates the first experimental evidence in live court cases that reducing information asymmetries results in a decrease in delay, an outcome predicted by many theories of bargaining. We also find that the information treatment is effective only when the plaintiff is present to receive it directly, suggesting agency issues between plaintiffs and their private lawyers. For most workers, the treatment appears to improve welfare, as measured by discounted payouts and ability to pay bills.
articles.abstract_cn: 运作良好的法院对金融和实体经济的健康至关重要。在大多数低收入国家，法院运作不佳，但表现不佳的根本原因尚不明确。我们利用正在进行的案件进行实地实验，分析墨西哥最大劳动法院的功能失调来源。我们向当事人提供案件结果的个性化预测，并表明这一信息使和解率几乎翻倍，并缩短了平均案件持续时间。该实验首次在真实法庭案件中提供了实验证据，表明减少信息不对称会导致延误减少，这是许多谈判理论所预测的结果。我们还发现，信息处理仅在原告在场直接接收时才有效，这表明原告与其私人律师之间存在代理问题。对于大多数工人来说，该处理似乎改善了福利，以折现赔付和支付账单的能力来衡量。

excluded_items.title_en: Correction to: Stability in Large Markets
Motives and Consequences of Libor Strategic Reporting: How Much Can We Learn from Banks’ Self-Reported Borrowing Rates?
